steps.en: Install the Watch plugin in local Claude Code and permit media-tool setup
steps.zh: 在本地 Claude Code 安装 Watch 并批准媒体工具准备

steps.en: Give the skill a short local video and a question; select local with no speech fallback
steps.zh: 给技能短本地视频与问题，选本地且关闭语音回退

steps.en: Extracts budgeted timestamped frames and reports available evidence
steps.zh: 按预算提取带时间戳的帧并报告可用证据

steps.en: Have the host inspect the listed images and answer from timestamps
steps.zh: 让宿主查看所列图像并据时间戳回答

value.en: A video question answered from visible evidence, with gaps made explicit
value.zh: 根据可见证据回答视频问题，并明确证据缺口
